title: Docs: connect masked decoder searches to retained rank-eight limits
head: bb436aa50cf989702f56a950af50df6990628ec9
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The decoder scope map sends masked searches outside its all-pairs theorems but does not point to the subsequently retained rank-eight E-graph obstructions. This one-file documentation change adds that route, so researchers can check an already-covered case before reopening it.

- Links PR1212, PR1389, PR1399 and PR1788 for P120, P112, P111 and the three P104 frame-complement orbits.
- Separates rank-eight sums from exactly eight costly terms, characteristic-zero rigidity from the cited real COPY floors, and frame complements from arbitrary punctures.
- Gives replay commands that check the retained predecessor blobs and execute zero-exclusion/transport checks, rather than merely citing them. Historical source wording remains untouched.

**Status: source-backed navigation, not a new theorem or independently implemented checker.** No construction, paid-profile, κ, selected-record or priority change. Physical realization, hosting, precision, all-size and analytic obligations remain outside this contribution.

This does not establish novelty across every diff or nested source file.

## Validation

All five newly documented commands passed on CPython 3.13.14:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/complex-rank8-decoder-rigidity/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/complex-rank8-decoder-rigidity/verify.py --live P120
python3 -I -B research/complex-rank8-rigidity-p111-p104-44/verify.py --pr1212-dir .
python3 -I -B research/complex-rank8-rigidity-p104-admissible/verify.py --pr1212-dir .
python3 -I -B research/e8-rank8-transport-audit/verify.py
```

The extension summaries report 35 and 22 checks with predecessor replay. The alternate-pivot verifier reports 2,025 frames, P104 orbits 28/336/896, and 2,501 RUP additions. Existing controls reject corrupted/truncated proofs, missing premises and invalid algebraic perturbations.

Also passed:

- The existing `python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'` suite: **65 tests**, CPython 3.12.13.
- Markdown local-link/fragment validation and `git diff --check`.
- A separate read-only Astra review of the new assertions against the written proofs and ledger. Its review-link label correction is included.
- Selected source bindings via `python3 -B scripts/research_baseline.py`.

Not run: a full selected-supplier cold replay, new F6 classification proof, or full multiplication-theorem formalization. The unchanged all-pairs commands were not rerun for this documentation-only addition. Local replay is not hosted CI or independent human review.

Substantial AI assistance: Hermes Agent (`gpt-6-astra-900k`) authored and checked the update; OpenAI Codex (`gpt-6-astra`, max reasoning) performed the source-fidelity review and identified the corrected citation labels.

## Open next questions

For a proposed masked decoder, first state its live-set geometry, field, costly term count and pairing bill. Check the applicable retained result and live overlap before synthesis. Higher-term cases are not settled by the cited rigidity chain, but this map does not certify that they are otherwise unexplored. A favorable identity still needs a fully priced realization before supplier admission.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
